Summary: Production security TLS and operations
Description: Make the public single-tenant Ubuntu service secure observable recoverable and supportable.
Acceptance Criteria: Trusted public access; tested recovery; actionable monitoring.

Summary: Replace self-signed public TLS certificate
Description: Issue a trusted certificate for the production hostname and make all public browser and API traffic validate normally.
Acceptance Criteria: A browser validates the complete certificate chain; HTTP redirects to HTTPS; TLS renewal is automated and documented.

Summary: Confirm production DNS hostname
Description: Record the canonical hostname and ensure its A or AAAA record points to the Ubuntu server.
Acceptance Criteria: Hostname and DNS ownership are recorded; DNS resolves to the intended server.

Summary: Configure ACME renewal and nginx TLS
Description: Install a trusted ACME certificate configure nginx and verify renewal without service interruption.
Acceptance Criteria: Strict TLS verification succeeds; renewal dry-run succeeds; no private key is in Git.

Summary: Implement encrypted off-host backups and restore rehearsal
Description: Automate PostgreSQL plus filestore backup to approved off-host storage and prove restoration on an isolated target.
Depends On: Approved backup storage and retention policy
Acceptance Criteria: Scheduled backups are encrypted; a restore produces a working isolated Odoo copy; measured RPO and RTO are recorded.

Summary: Define backup retention and access policy
Description: Obtain business approval for retention encryption owners and recovery objectives.
Acceptance Criteria: Policy identifies retention RPO RTO storage owner and restore approver.

Summary: Automate database and filestore backup
Description: Create a least-privilege scheduled backup job covering PostgreSQL and the active filestore.
Acceptance Criteria: Backup job exits non-zero on failure; artifacts are encrypted and off-host; logs are retained.

Summary: Rehearse isolated restore
Description: Restore a selected backup to an isolated environment and verify login attachments and reports.
Acceptance Criteria: Restore report includes timestamp source backup SHA/ID application health attachment check and sign-off.

Summary: Implement production monitoring and alerting
Description: Monitor the actual silent failures relevant to Odoo rather than only host reachability.
Acceptance Criteria: Alerts cover private health PostgreSQL availability disk/backup failure Odoo crash loops and certificate expiry.

Summary: Add health and service probes
Description: Monitor Odoo private health PostgreSQL connectivity and systemd active state.
Acceptance Criteria: Probe has documented thresholds and alerts after the agreed failure window.

Summary: Add certificate backup and disk alerts
Description: Alert before certificate expiry on failed backup and on capacity exhaustion.
Acceptance Criteria: Alert tests are recorded and routed to the named operator.

Summary: Complete production access and secret review
Description: Inventory GitHub environment secrets server accounts SSH keys and sudo permissions; rotate or revoke anything no longer required.
Acceptance Criteria: No unused deploy key or credential remains; production secrets are environment-scoped; access review is signed off.

Summary: Release engineering and environment governance
Description: Keep PR quality staging automation and manual production promotion reliable auditable and recoverable.
Acceptance Criteria: Every release is traceable from PR to tested staged revision to manual production promotion.

Summary: Complete and verify production promotion workflow
Description: Merge the native production bootstrap correction and test a no-op or approved promotion through the final workflow path.
Acceptance Criteria: Workflow streams the approved deployment script before checkout; captures rollback revision; uses key-verified SSH; validates loopback health.

Summary: Verify workflow fix merged and branch deleted
Description: Confirm the protected PR auto-merges after CI and its remote branch is removed by repository policy.
Acceptance Criteria: Main contains the correction; PR is merged; feature branch is deleted; required checks remain enforced.

Summary: Exercise controlled deployment audit
Description: Run a documented approved deployment and retain selected SHA deployment result service health and rollback evidence.
Acceptance Criteria: Deployment record identifies actor SHA staging run production run and post-deploy health result.

Summary: Set runner and Podman staging operational checks
Description: Detect an offline Windows staging runner stopped Podman machine failed registry login or stale staging health.
Acceptance Criteria: Runner availability Podman machine container health and staging endpoint are observable; recovery instructions are tested.

Summary: Document release rollback and change approval
Description: Create one operational runbook for release approval deployment rollback and incident escalation.
Acceptance Criteria: Runbook has an owner; rollback uses the prior immutable revision; production approval remains manual.

Summary: Bikram Sambat platform and reporting
Description: Complete correct user-facing BS dates across operational flows reports and period analysis while retaining Gregorian storage.
Acceptance Criteria: BS is correct at the UI/report boundary across the agreed business scope.

Summary: Certify BS date coverage for inventory purchase and sales
Description: Expand and verify BS presentation for the agreed high-value operational date fields including stock purchase and sale flows.
Acceptance Criteria: All agreed high-value date fields render and accept BS dates; AD storage and API behavior stay unchanged.

Summary: Prioritize operational date fields
Description: Approve the exact stock purchase sale and inventory date fields that require BS UI coverage at go-live.
Acceptance Criteria: Signed field matrix classifies required deferred and excluded fields.

Summary: Implement and test selected BS field coverage
Description: Apply the central field behavior to selected views and add regression tests for each model family.
Acceptance Criteria: Selected fields pass create edit search and display tests using BS input and Gregorian stored values.

Summary: Add BS report output across statutory and financial reports
Description: Apply central company-configured AD BS or both-date formatting to approved QWeb financial VAT and TDS outputs.
Acceptance Criteria: PDF and HTML outputs honor company setting; report amounts and date domains remain Gregorian; output tests cover AD BS and both.

Summary: Implement central QWeb BS formatter
Description: Provide the report formatter and configuration resolution without per-report duplicate date logic.
Acceptance Criteria: Formatter is centrally tested and supports AD BS and both modes.

Summary: Convert financial VAT and TDS templates
Description: Adopt the central formatter in approved financial VAT and TDS report templates.
Acceptance Criteria: Representative PDFs show the configured date convention and retain valid source dates.

Summary: Deliver BS-aware period filters and grouping
Description: Design BS-month filtering and reporting group boundaries without persisting misleading BS dates.
Acceptance Criteria: Users filter by BS periods and group correctly across variable-length BS months; performance is measured.

Summary: Nepal accounting core and financial reporting
Description: Complete accounting correctness usability and reconciliation of financial reports across Nepali fiscal years.
Epic Name: Nepal accounting core and financial reporting
Acceptance Criteria: Financial outputs reconcile to journal items and are accepted through representative fiscal-year scenarios.

Summary: Correct prior-year unallocated earnings in Balance Sheet
Description: Ensure the Balance Sheet includes prior-year earnings so it remains balanced after the first fiscal year.
Acceptance Criteria: A prior fiscal-year posting results in a balanced Balance Sheet; regression test fails if the line is removed.

Summary: Create multi-fiscal-year accounting fixture
Description: Create posted current and prior fiscal-year entries with expected cumulative balance-sheet values.
Acceptance Criteria: Fixture is isolated deterministic and documents expected earnings values.

Summary: Implement earnings calculation and report assertion
Description: Implement the calculation and assert assets equal liabilities plus equity across fiscal years.
Acceptance Criteria: Statement renders and balances in HTML PDF and regression test paths.

Summary: Build and reconcile Cash Flow Statement
Description: Extend financial statements with an indirect-method cash flow statement that ties opening/closing cash to accounting data.
Acceptance Criteria: Closing cash equals asset_cash ledger balance and the movement ties to the Balance Sheet.

Summary: Define account-type classification and fixture
Description: Define operating investing financing classification using account types and create representative journals.
Acceptance Criteria: Classification decision is documented; fixture covers all three sections and non-cash adjustments.

Summary: Render cash flow with drill-down and tie-out
Description: Implement report output with journal-item traceability and reconciliation assertions.
Acceptance Criteria: HTML/PDF render; every figure traces to journal items; closing cash tie-out passes.

Summary: Complete bank matching operational acceptance
Description: Validate the existing Community bank matching path with real bank-statement scenarios and document supported versus deferred behavior.
Acceptance Criteria: Outstanding payment clearing works for approved cases; limitations and user procedure are signed off.

Summary: Execute bank matching acceptance scenarios
Description: Test customer receipt vendor payment partial payment and unmatched line scenarios.
Acceptance Criteria: Each scenario posts correct reconciliation state and accounting entries.

Summary: Publish accountant reconciliation procedure
Description: Document user steps exceptions and escalation when automated matching is unavailable.
Acceptance Criteria: Accountant can complete the approved scenarios without developer access.

Summary: Nepal statutory VAT TDS and compliance
Description: Build configurable statutory capabilities only after authoritative Nepali CA inputs and acceptance are available.
Epic Name: Nepal statutory VAT TDS and compliance
Acceptance Criteria: No statutory figure is treated as compliant without CA-approved inputs and sample-period reconciliation.

Summary: Run Nepal CA statutory configuration workshop
Description: Obtain authoritative signed inputs for entity type chart VAT TDS depreciation fiscal period and statutory output language.
Depends On: Named Nepali CA and source documents
Acceptance Criteria: Signed decision register supplies every required input or explicitly defers it.

Summary: Confirm entity chart and fiscal-year policy
Description: Confirm entity type NFRS/NPSAS chart codes and Shrawan-to-Ashar fiscal-year policy.
Acceptance Criteria: CA-approved chart and fiscal-year decision is attached to Jira.

Summary: Confirm VAT TDS and depreciation source data
Description: Collect dated rate threshold exemption certificate form and depreciation requirements from authoritative sources.
Acceptance Criteria: Source documents and effective dates are attached and approved by the CA.

Summary: Implement versioned IRD VAT return framework
Description: Build editable versioned return forms and box-to-tax-tag mapping then validate an actual filing period to the rupee.
Acceptance Criteria: Filed return preserves its form version; each box traces to tagged journal lines; CA agrees results to the rupee.

Summary: Model versioned VAT forms and boxes
Description: Implement effective-dated editable form and box records with tax-tag or safe formula mapping.
Acceptance Criteria: Historical returns retain their original definition and mappings are auditable.

Summary: Validate VAT migration and non-zero boxes
Description: Create fixture and migration checks ensuring tagged posted invoices populate expected return boxes without skips.
Acceptance Criteria: Reverting the tag migration fails the test; domestic and export cases reconcile to the ledger.

Summary: Implement configurable TDS certificates and returns
Description: Complete effective-dated TDS configuration deduction certificate and periodic return workflows using CA-approved data.
Acceptance Criteria: Rates are editable and date-bounded; certificates and returns reproduce CA-approved sample periods.

Summary: Configure effective-dated TDS categories
Description: Implement category rate threshold exemption account and effective-date records.
Acceptance Criteria: Historical calculations use the applicable dated category and changes are auditable.

Summary: Render and validate TDS certificate and return
Description: Implement approved certificate fields return aggregation and accountant sample-period comparison.
Acceptance Criteria: Certificate and return totals tie to withholding lines and CA approval is attached.

Summary: Decide and implement Nepal depreciation method
Description: Implement pooled/block depreciation only if CA confirms it is required; otherwise document OCA asset method acceptance.
Acceptance Criteria: Decision is signed; accepted method matches a CA manual sample across a fiscal year.

Summary: Build bilingual annual statutory report pack
Description: Produce the CA-approved annual statement package in Nepali fiscal periods with configured BS/both dates.
Depends On: S7; S9; S10; S11; CA language decision
Acceptance Criteria: Full year-end package is generated and accepted by the CA; figures trace to journals.

Summary: Quality upgrades and supply-chain assurance
Description: Protect the custom modules from regressions upgrade failures and untracked third-party drift.
Acceptance Criteria: Fresh installs upgrades and critical accounting/reporting paths are repeatably verified.

Summary: Expand deterministic automated test coverage
Description: Replace residual environment-dependent behavior with fixtures and cover JS XML monetary and report-rendering paths.
Acceptance Criteria: Tests are deterministic from a clean database and report skips as failures where required.

Summary: Add JavaScript BS and workflow tests
Description: Cover date widgets BS preference report behavior and client-side regression paths.
Acceptance Criteria: Relevant JS suites run in CI and catch a broken BS rendering path.

Summary: Standardize XML and monetary assertions
Description: Adopt shared XML well-formedness and precision-safe monetary assertion helpers across local modules.
Acceptance Criteria: All local module XML is covered; money tests do not rely on binary float equality.

Summary: Create upgrade rehearsal and migration policy
Description: Define module versioning migration scaffolding and a scratch upgrade rehearsal that protects data and translations.
Acceptance Criteria: Upgrade rehearsal completes from a production-like copy; translations survive; version/migration checks are documented.

Summary: Pin vendored OCA provenance
Description: Record exact upstream SHAs license and local overlay rationale for each vendored dependency.
Acceptance Criteria: Every vendored module maps to immutable source SHA license and approved local overlay.

Summary: Run translation-preserving upgrade rehearsal
Description: Exercise module upgrade and verify generated Nepal translations and report assets remain present.
Acceptance Criteria: Rehearsal evidence identifies command output translation counts and remediation steps.

Summary: Decide AGPL and Odoo core supply policy
Description: Obtain legal and engineering decision for AGPL obligations and the supported Odoo core update source.
Acceptance Criteria: Decision records distribution obligations core source pinning and security-update process.

Summary: Data lifecycle and disaster recovery governance
Description: Govern production data retention recoverability and approved cleanup decisions.
Epic Name: Data lifecycle and disaster recovery governance
Acceptance Criteria: Production data has approved retention recovery and disposal controls.

Summary: Define data retention and recovery governance
Description: Document owner-approved retention classification legal hold recovery evidence and secure disposal requirements.
Acceptance Criteria: Policy covers database filestore backups logs exported reports and credentials; owners are named.

Summary: Approve or retain reconciled orphaned Downloads tree
Description: Make an explicit recoverable cleanup decision for the already-reconciled non-business local Downloads data.
Acceptance Criteria: Decision and evidence are recorded; if deleted, removal is confirmed and no business attachment is affected.

Summary: Audit attachment integrity on recovery cycles
Description: Include attachment byte-read and filestore/database consistency checks in scheduled recovery verification.
Acceptance Criteria: Recovery verification identifies referenced missing blobs and proves representative business attachment downloads.

Summary: Future SaaS multi-tenant platform
Description: Future only: build tenant isolation provisioning lifecycle and scale controls after the single-tenant product is stable.
Acceptance Criteria: No tenant is onboarded until isolation lifecycle and recovery gates pass.

Summary: Write cross-tenant isolation suite before SaaS changes
Description: Create two-real-database tests for routing session records cron mail and administrative boundary isolation.
Acceptance Criteria: All isolation tests pass before db_name removal or second tenant provisioning.

Summary: Test hostile database selection paths
Description: Test Host X-Forwarded-Host query db header and authentication database selection against non-matching tenant access.
Acceptance Criteria: Forged routing inputs cannot select another tenant database.

Summary: Test session cron and mail containment
Description: Prove tenant A cannot revoke tenant B sessions and a suspended tenant runs no cron or mail.
Acceptance Criteria: Tests demonstrate zero cross-tenant session cron and mail effects.

Summary: Implement tenant routing cron and session containment
Description: Apply anchored dbfilter proxy header pinning cron allowlist and chosen session isolation design as one safe release.
Acceptance Criteria: Two tenants route only by real host; no cross-tenant cron/session behavior; all isolation tests pass.

Summary: Automate tenant provisioning suspension offboarding and restore
Description: Provide audited lifecycle scripts for tenant database filestore mail routing backup restore and secure deletion.
Acceptance Criteria: A tenant can be provisioned suspended restored and offboarded with no residue and documented evidence.

Summary: Plan SaaS capacity controls
Description: Introduce PgBouncer and cron scaling only after measured tenant-count thresholds and workload evidence.
Acceptance Criteria: Connection and cron capacity decisions are based on measured workload and target tenant count.

Summary: Regulatory registration and IRD compliance
Description: Establish the statutory permissions required before Odoo may lawfully act as the billing system for a VAT-registered Nepali vendor.
Acceptance Criteria: Every registration or approval required to operate the billing system lawfully is obtained and evidenced before go-live.

Summary: Establish IRD billing-software approval and CBMS applicability
Description: Determine with IRD and the engaged CA whether the deployment requires billing-software registration or approval, and whether real-time invoice reporting applies at this turnover band.
Acceptance Criteria: A written determination states which registrations apply, the application route, the lead time and the evidence required. Nothing is assumed from precedent.

Summary: Obtain IRD billing-software approval
Description: Complete whatever registration or approval SP3 identifies, and retain the evidence for audit.
Acceptance Criteria: Given the determination from SP3, when the application route is followed, then approval is granted and the evidence is retained before the first live invoice is issued.

Summary: Record entity type PAN and VAT registration in company configuration
Description: Capture entity type, PAN, VAT registration number and filing frequency on the company record so statutory output can cite them.
Acceptance Criteria: Given the confirmed entity facts, when a statutory document is rendered, then it carries the correct PAN and registration details from configuration rather than hardcoded text.

Summary: Statutory printable output
Description: Produce the physical documents the law requires: a TDS certificate that can be issued to a deductee and a VAT return that can be filed.
Acceptance Criteria: Every statutory document exists as an approved rendered artefact, not only as a screen record.

Summary: Build TDS certificate report template
Description: l10n_np_tds has no report directory, no QWeb template and no report action. A certificate must be issuable to the deductee.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an issued certificate, when it is printed, then the PDF carries every mandatory field in the CA-approved layout and the figures tie to the withholding lines.

Summary: Implement TDS certificate QWeb template and PDF action
Description: Add a report directory, QWeb template and ir.actions.report to l10n_np_tds.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a certificate in issued state, when the print action runs, then HTML and PDF render without error and BS dates honour the company setting.

Summary: Obtain CA approval of TDS certificate layout
Description: Register item 3. The figures are correct; the layout has never been reviewed.
Acceptance Criteria: The CA confirms in writing that the rendered certificate satisfies the statutory format and mandatory fields.

Summary: Build VAT return report template
Description: l10n_np_vat_return computes boxes but has no printable output and no filing export.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a computed return, when it is printed, then the output reproduces the IRD form box for box and every figure traces to tagged journal lines.

Summary: Implement VAT return QWeb template and PDF action
Description: Add a report directory, QWeb template and ir.actions.report to l10n_np_vat_return.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a computed return, when the print action runs, then HTML and PDF render with bilingual box labels drawn from the form definition.

Summary: Obtain CA approval of VAT return layout
Description: Register item 4 covers the box definitions; this covers the rendered artefact.
Acceptance Criteria: The CA confirms the rendered return matches the IRD form currently in force.

Summary: Opening balances and cut-over
Description: Move the entity from manual and spreadsheet books into Odoo at the Shrawan 1 2084 fiscal-year boundary, with evidence an auditor can rely on.
Acceptance Criteria: Opening balances are posted, reconciled and signed, and one full period has been run in parallel before cut-over.

Summary: Map spreadsheet trial balance to the signed chart
Description: Produce a line-by-line mapping from the existing manual books to the CA-signed chart of accounts.
Acceptance Criteria: Given the closing trial balance, when it is mapped, then every source balance lands on exactly one target account and the mapping totals agree to the source.

Summary: Post opening balance journal at Ashad end 2083/84
Description: Build and post the opening entry as at 16 July 2027 with full sub-ledger detail.
Acceptance Criteria: Given the mapped trial balance, when the opening journal is posted, then the resulting balance sheet equals the signed closing position and the entry balances.

Summary: Load debtor and creditor sub-ledger detail
Description: Opening receivables and payables must carry per-partner detail, not a single control total.
Acceptance Criteria: Given the opening entry, when the partner ledger is run, then per-partner balances sum to the control account and each open item carries its original date.

Summary: Load stock valuation and fixed asset register with opening WDV
Description: Opening stock valuation and the asset register including written-down value per depreciation block.
Acceptance Criteria: Given the opening entry, when the asset register is listed, then each asset carries its block, cost and opening WDV, and the total agrees to the control account.

Summary: Execute parallel run and produce reconciliation pack
Description: Run at least one full VAT period in both systems and reconcile to the rupee before relying on Odoo alone.
Acceptance Criteria: Given one full VAT period run in both systems, when the results are compared, then VAT return boxes, TDS deductions and the trial balance agree to the rupee, and differences are explained in writing.

Summary: Run one full VAT period in parallel
Description: Post the same period in both the manual books and Odoo.
Acceptance Criteria: Given identical source documents, when both systems are closed for the period, then the VAT return figures match to the rupee.

Summary: Produce auditor reconciliation pack
Description: Retain the comparison, explanations and sign-off as audit evidence.
Acceptance Criteria: The pack identifies the period, both sources, every difference with its explanation, and carries CA sign-off.

Summary: Confirm Nepali-language statutory output requirement
Description: Register item 8 - whether Nepali-language statutory output is mandatory or optional. Had no Jira coverage.
Acceptance Criteria: The CA states in writing whether Nepali-language output is mandatory, for which documents, and whether bilingual presentation satisfies it.

Summary: Confirm retention and audit-trail requirements
Description: Register item 9 - statutory record retention and audit-trail obligations. Had no Jira coverage.
Acceptance Criteria: The CA states the retention period, the records in scope, and the audit-trail evidence a reviewer may require.

Summary: Derive VAT return periods from Bikram Sambat months
Description: VAT return date_from and date_to are plain date fields with no default and no BS-month generator, yet Nepali VAT is filed per BS month.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a BS month and year, when a VAT return is created, then date_from and date_to are the correct Gregorian boundaries of that BS month, proven by test across a full year.

Summary: Implement TDS threshold enforcement and category linkage
Description: threshold is declared and documented but no code reads it, and certificate line category_id is never populated, so a certificate cannot state which rate applied.
Acceptance Criteria: Given cumulative payments below the threshold, when withholding is computed, then no TDS is deducted; and given a collected certificate line, when it is inspected, then category_id names the applicable category and legal reference.

Summary: Implement TDS return aggregation and filing
Description: l10n_np.tds.return is a data shell with no methods, no file action and no tests. Certificates must be attached by hand.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a period, when the return is generated, then it collects the period certificates automatically, totals tie to the withholding lines, and it cannot be filed before it is computed.

Summary: Effective-date the VAT standard rate
Description: TDS rates and VAT form versions are properly date-bounded; the 13 percent rate itself is a bare CSV value with no historical-correctness mechanism.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a rate change with an effective date, when a historical period is recomputed, then it uses the rate in force on the transaction date.

Summary: Export fiscal position auto-applies to foreign vendors
Description: The Export position has auto_apply with no country and no country group, so it zero-rates import purchases. Nepali reverse-charge on imported services would make that wrong.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a foreign vendor bill, when the fiscal position is resolved, then the export zero-rating does not apply to purchases, proven by a regression test.

Summary: TDS certificate sequence uses the Gregorian year
Description: The sequence prefix interpolates range_year, so certificates read TDS/2026 where the fiscal year is 2083/84, and the series rolls over mid Nepali fiscal year.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a certificate issued in Bhadra 2083, when its number is inspected, then it cites the Nepali fiscal year and the series does not roll over before Ashad end.

Summary: Model book versus tax depreciation and deferred tax
Description: NFRS book depreciation and Income Tax Act Schedule 2 pooled depreciation diverge, creating deferred tax that nothing currently computes.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a fiscal year with both book and tax depreciation, when the deferred tax computation runs, then the movement reconciles to the temporary difference and ties to the CA manual computation.

Summary: Complete the statutory statement set
Description: No Statement of Changes in Equity, no notes or schedules, and no comparative prior-year column.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a closed fiscal year, when the statutory pack is produced, then it includes a Statement of Changes in Equity, supporting notes and prior-year comparatives, and every figure traces to journal items.

Summary: Balance Sheet header prints the fiscal year in Gregorian
Description: The financial statements template uses t-esc on raw dates for the fiscal-year line, bypassing the BS converter, so one header line shows Gregorian beside BS.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a company set to BS output, when the Balance Sheet renders, then the fiscal-year header line shows BS dates like every other date on the report.

Summary: Ship fiscal-year records as data and make the fallback loud
Description: l10n_np_fiscal_year ships no data file. Absent a record, compute_fiscalyear_dates silently falls back to a fixed day and month pair and can return a range wrong by one day.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a Nepal company and no generated fiscal year, when a statutory report is run, then the system warns or refuses rather than returning a silently wrong range; and shipped data covers BS 2075 to 2095.

Summary: Set company country to Nepal and currency to NPR
Description: The company record is the untouched Odoo default - My Company, country US, currency USD. Correcting country and currency is safe now and is independent of the chart decision.
Acceptance Criteria: Given zero journal entries, when the company is reconfigured, then country is Nepal and currency is NPR, and no chart template has been adopted.

Summary: Adopt the signed Nepal chart of accounts
Description: Chart templates apply at adoption, not on upgrade, so the chart must not be adopted until the CA has signed it. Adopting the current 43-account skeleton first would force a migration to reach the signed chart - exactly what the zero-journal-entry window exists to avoid.
Acceptance Criteria: Given the CA-signed chart and zero journal entries, when the chart is adopted, then the signed accounts are active and tax tags are present on the tax repartition lines.

Summary: Define retention and audit-trail policy
Description: Register item 9 has no owner. The hash-chain audit trail exists but no policy governs retention, disposal or the evidence a reviewer may require.
Acceptance Criteria: The policy names the retention period, the records in scope, the disposal method and the owner, and is consistent with the CA determination in ST41.
